public.regime_lens: 🚦 RED — both hard deployment gates (TNX, CCC OAS) deteriorated further this week while the geopolitical shock layer sharply re-escalated in parallel, rather than offsetting it · base: Geopolitical Stagflation over Policy Transition, with the fiscal/duration-stress overlay (record US debt, 19-year-high long yields) now compounding a freshly hawkish Fed reaction function under Chair Warsh (explicit inflation-fighting rhetoric, market pricing a coin-flip-plus hike for Sept 16) → WORSENING · shock: two active tracks, now moving in the SAME direction (worsening) rather than diverging as in the prior two updates: (1) Iran/Hormuz — re-escalated hard this week; the US struck Iranian tankers for the first time (Sept 1-2, new "tanker for tanker" policy), and the Strait is reported effectively closed (5-11 vessels/day vs a 13/day 10-day average); Brent spiked ~9% w/w and ~21% m/m to ~$96; (2) a fiscal/duration-stress shock that remains unresolved — 30Y still near its 19-year high above 5.25%, the most recent 30Y auction (mid-August) cleared at the highest yield since 2001 on weak demand, and US federal debt remains above $40T · action: RED = no new deployment; new-tranche silver stays mechanically BLOCKED on both hard rails — TNX 4... (refreshed 2026-09-06)

level_id_bank.verdict: Positional UPTREND, near-term CORRECTIVE — buy-the-dip-don't-chase, with the dip now ARRIVING. POWERINDIA ran parabolically to a fresh ATH ~38,785 then sold off ~11% (1M candle -9.99%) into 34,590, landing exactly on the canonical buy box 33,754-34,309 (base 2.618 + refine 1.0/1.115 + SMA50 + EMA36 — a 5-source stack). The secular structure is intact (price +89% on the 12M, BMSB 30,738 sits far below, EMA200 25,929 far below), but the 1D Supertrend just flipped RED (38,193) and price is under the EMA21/4h-SMA, so the immediate momentum is down. Read: this is the pullback the skill flagged to wait for — buy the 33,754-34,309 box (not the extended print), stop on a daily close that loses the box + the 1M low (<33,000), which opens the deeper 30,370-31,236 BMSB zone for a heavier add. Targets zone-to-zone: reclaim 35,000-35,696 -> 36,400-37,100 (trim-40) -> the 38,193-38,785 ATH cap; an ATH breakout unlocks 42,000-44,000. Do NOT chase into the 38k supply on a bounce — that's the level it's correcting from.
